mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have lovely clear skies and a temperature of 77 degrees, with a feels-like temperature of 79 degrees at Reddan Soccer Park.

The Plan Commission meets on the first Monday of every month at City Hall to review development proposals. Additionally, the Verona Police Department is currently seeking applicants for a part-time records clerk and lateral transfer police officers to join their team.

There is plenty to do in our community today, starting with trivia at Hop Haus and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, check out the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market at Hometown Junction Park, or enjoy some live music and trivia at Paddy Mac's and The Bogey Factory.

In our weekly police report, on August 21, an officer conducted a traffic stop for expired registration and cited the driver for possession of marijuana after detecting the odor of the substance in the vehicle.
Today's delicious flavor of the day is Dark Chocolate PB Crunch. You can stop by for a scoop anytime until they close at 10 PM tonight.
